visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + optional text + optional buttons
visualCharacteristics.notes: Default: dark rgba(0,0,0,.5) band 75% wide bottom-left, H1 (home) or H1 + text + blue buttons (about/play). centered: text centered over full-image tint, white pill buttons in a row. light: white translucent band, dark text, uppercase semibold subtitle.

contentPattern: 1 column; row 1 image; row 2 heading + optional text + optional CTAs
